short: Organising who waits, for how long, and what they are told.
seoTitle: Queue Management — Meaning, Formula and Example
metaDescription: Organising who waits, for how long, and what they are told. Most walkaways happen because the wait is unknown, not because it is long.
definition: Queue management organises waiting customers — a waitlist, an estimated wait, a notification when the table or order is ready — instead of leaving people standing at the entrance.
bodyHtml:
Why Queue Management matters

Most walkaways happen because the wait is unknown, not because it is long. Telling someone it is twenty minutes and messaging them when ready converts a walkaway into a cover.

Queue Management formula

Estimated wait = Parties ahead × Average table turn time ÷ Number of comparable tables

Track estimate accuracy, since credibility is what makes waiting acceptable.

How Queue Management works in practice

Capture the party size and phone number, give an honest estimate, and notify when ready. Recording actual waits against estimates makes the next estimate credible.

faq.question: Does a queue system reduce walkaways?
faq.answer: Materially, because customers who know the wait and can leave and return are far more likely to stay in the queue.

faq.question: What data should a queue system capture?
faq.answer: Party size, contact number, quoted wait and actual wait — the last one is what improves the rest.
